title: Pickers, card editor and 3D printer discovery

TileEditorWide.dc.html.title: Wide window: form and preview side by side

n-filterpicker.text: Normal stage. Every type has its icon in a tonal circle. The search field is pinned above the list with a match count and a clear button; the Any chip clears the selection. Types that were selected when the list opened sit at the top; a type ticked now stays where it is until the list is opened again, so rows never jump under a finger. Try: tick rows, type "se", press Any. Unbuilt: all of it; today this is a plain checkbox list. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-filterpickernomatch.text: Empty stage: the search matches no type. The selection is kept and said to be kept. Try: Clear search, or delete the text. Unbuilt: all of it. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-filterpickerloading.text: Loading stage: placeholder rows in the shape of the real rows, the match count hidden until there is something to count. Reduced motion or the motion tweak stops the shimmer. Unbuilt: all of it. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-filterpickererror.text: Error stage: the list could not be read. The current filter stays applied. Try: Try again returns to the list. Unbuilt: all of it. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-filterpickerwide.text: Wide window: the same picker as a side panel beside the entities table. Removing a chip above the table unticks the type in the panel. The stage tweak shows no-match, loading and error here too. Below about 880 px the table moves under the panel. Unbuilt: all of it; the table rows are 12 sample entities. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

t-filters.text: Filter pickers: the entity type filter with icons, search and a match count

n-tileeditor.text: Normal stage. Bottom sheet with the header, Search this dialog, the four tabs and a compact live preview pinned above the form. Only the form scrolls, and Cancel and Save stay in a footer that never covers a field. Try: change the name or color and watch the preview, switch tabs, search "color". Unbuilt: the pinned preview and footer layout; the search here filters the Config tab only, the built search should cover all four tabs. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-tileeditornoentity.text: Empty stage: a new card with no entity. The preview says what is missing and Save is off. Try: tap the Entity field to pick the sample entity. Unbuilt: the empty preview message. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-tileeditorloading.text: Loading stage: the configuration is being read. Header, search and tabs are already in place so nothing shifts when the form arrives. Unbuilt: placeholder rows. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-tileeditorerror.text: Error stage: the saved entity no longer exists. The message is at the top of the form, the field is marked and Save is off until another entity is picked. Try: tap the Entity field. Unbuilt: the message placement and the marked preview. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-stackeditor.text: Vertical stack card: the cards in the stack are a scrolling strip of numbered tabs with Add at the end, then move earlier, move later and remove for the chosen card, then that card's own form. Try: pick a card, move it, add one, remove one. Unbuilt: the strip and its three buttons as drawn; the child form shown is the Tile form for every card. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-tileeditorwide.text: Wide window: a dialog with the form on the left and the preview on the right, so the preview never pushes the form down. The stage tweak shows no-entity, loading, error and stack. Under about 900 px the preview moves above the form. Unbuilt: the two-column layout. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

t-editor.text: Card editor: the Tile card edit sheet on a phone, and a stack card

n-printerdiscovered.text: Normal stage. A Bambu Lab printer found on the network: name, model, masked serial and address. Try: Show reveals the sample serial, Add opens the access code step, Ignore leaves the none-found stage. All data is made up (192.0.2.x addresses, sample serials). Unbuilt: the masked serial with Show. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printeraccesscode.text: Step 2 of 3: the access code, where to find it on the printer, a show or hide button and a character count. Try: type 8 characters and press Connect; it connects, then lands on the printer list with a confirmation. Fewer than 8 characters gives a plain message. Unbuilt: the step bar and the character count. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printerwrongcode.text: Error stage: the printer refused the code. The field is marked and the message says where to look. Typing again clears the error. Unbuilt: nothing beyond the step itself. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printersearching.text: Loading stage: looking for printers, with a progress bar and a placeholder card. The refresh button in the top bar runs this search and ends on the discovered card. Unbuilt: the placeholder card. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printernonefound.text: Empty stage: nothing answered. Says what has to be true for a printer to be found and offers Search again or Add by address. Unbuilt: the Add by address path beyond the access code step. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printermoved.text: The printer list after an address change: a notification card and a toast "Printer moved to a new address and reconnected", the old and new address, and "Auto-bound by serial" on each printer. Try: Simulate an address change, Dismiss. Unbuilt: the notification card; the toast and the tag are the parts to build first. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-printerdiscoverywide.text: Wide window: discovered devices on the left, the printer list on the right, the access code step as a centred dialog and the toast at the bottom right. The stage tweak shows every stage. Under about 800 px the two columns stack. Unbuilt: the two-column page. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

t-printer.text: 3D printer discovery: found on the network, access code, and reconnecting after an address change
